name: Taiwan Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified): 243 closures (79 with exchange_calendars' names, 164 'Historical Holiday'), no early closes; exchange_calendars has 09:00-13:30 on every session. 2025-2027: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications. 2028-2029: standing pattern; TWSE has not published them, so every 2028-2029 entry carries predicted: true and the ' (predicted)' suffix (4c9); entries that cited press (taiwannews) now cite TWSE's open data, the schedule whose pattern they follow. Checked 2026-11-20 (4c8). Last published year: TWSE's holiday-schedule open data (https://www.twse.com.tw/holidaySchedule/holidaySchedule?response=open_data, which serves the current schedule, read as ROC 116 = 2027) lists the 2027 closures. Fixed against it: 2027-02-02 and 2027-02-03 are the two no-trading settlement-only days (both libraries trade them; 2027-02-03's 'unpublished' triage verdict became part of the library_error verdict for 2027-02-02 in 4d.1, and the Commercial Times' report of TWSE's 116 schedule, https://www.ctee.com.tw/news/20261116700032-439901, gives the same: last trading day 2/1, '2/2~3無交易，僅辦理結算交割作業') (the registry had 02-03 and 02-04); 2027-02-04 is part of the Lunar New Year holiday (Feb 4-10); 2027-04-06 (Children's Day observed) and 2027-12-24 (Constitution Day observed) were missing. Every 2027 entry now cites the open data; six had cited press pages (chinatimes, storm.mg). One-off closures (4c9): 2026-07-10 (Typhoon Bavi) and 2026-10-23 (Typhoon Champi) are in ad_hoc_closures (moved there in 4c10, maintainer decision: unscheduled closures go in ad_hoc_closures; the 2010-2024 typhoon days from the exchange_calendars backfill stay in holidays.explicit as part of that backfill). TWSE's rule (trading-system page, https://www.twse.com.tw/zh/products/system/trading.html) is that in a natural disaster the centralized market closes according to whether the Mayor of Taipei announces a work suspension for Taipei's public agencies that day. The Taipei City Government Department of Personnel's list of natural-disaster work suspensions (https://dop.gov.taipei/cp.aspx?n=EFE42F770DFD63FB) records 'stop work and classes' for 10 July 2026 (Bavi) and 23 October 2026 (Champi); both are weekdays. TWSE's own closure notices for the two days could not be read (twse.com.tw and investoredu.twse.com.tw return a security error or a CDN error page to this sandbox), so both dates are marked unconfirmed on the 2025-2027 span until a TWSE URL is cited. Close (ADR 0013): TWSE's trading-system page (https://www.twse.com.tw/zh/products/system/trading.html) gives matching 9:00-13:30 with a closing call auction 13:25-13:30 and the closing match at 13:30; only securities that hit the closing-delay threshold close at 13:33, which ADR 0013 ignores. regular_hours.close stays 13:30, now as one dated entry from 2010-01-01 (unconfirmed on the 2010-2024 span: no earlier TWSE schedule was read; exchange_calendars agrees for 2010-2024). No early closes exist.
